evidence.quote: # Abstract Existing Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR) is limited to coarse-grained understanding that hinders precise video moment localization when given fine-grained queries.

background_setup.summary: # Introduction Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR) aims to retrieve a video moment from a large untrimmed video corpus given a text query.

evidence.quote: # Introduction Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR) [1] aims to retrieve a video moment from a large untrimmed video corpus given a text query.

background_setup.summary: It requires handling two subtasks: Video Retrieval (VR) from a corpus and Single Video Moment Retreival (SVMR) within a video, which involves grasping multi-level semantic granularities across video-text and moment-text alignment.

evidence.quote: It requires handling two subtasks: Video Retrieval (VR) [2] from a corpus and Single Video Moment Retreival (SVMR) [3, 4] within a video, which involves grasping multi-level semantic granularities across video-text and moment-text alignment.
